title: Serve parity: Alpaca IEX clock-hour 1h bars (incl. extended hours) vs the regular-session :30 bars RQ-20261101-bdc2-01 scored ml_entry on; measure the feature and decision-clock difference on alpaca_paper
note: Filed 2026-11-01 by lane ALPACA-LIVE-ACTIVITY-ML on the manager instruction (12:37Z): "file a dated serve-parity row: owner manager, due_by 2026-11-03, measuring the difference between Alpaca IEX clock-hour bars and regular-session bars. Paper can proceed." MEASURED in code: src/exchange/alpaca_connector.py::get_ohlcv requests /v2/stocks/{sym}/bars with the IEX feed and no session filter; bar t = bar START on the clock hour, so live 1h bars include pre/post-market trades and differ from the Yahoo regular-session :30 bars the one-read scored. Consequences to measure: (1) is_decision_bar fires at UTC close hours %4==0 incl. extended-hours bars (00/08/12 UTC) where a bracket cannot be placed; (2) ret_k / vol24 / ATR14 / range_pos counted over extended-hours bars. Method: pull 30 sessions of Alpaca IEX 1h bars and Yahoo RTH bars for the 13 alpaca_paper ETFs, compute the 20 features at each decision bar both ways, report the per-feature gap and the decision agreement (taken / side) of the frozen model. 2026-11-02 17:20Z (ALPACA-ML final, #22282 merged, deployed at 24fbc0e, observed at the 16:00Z decision): 13/13 ETFs evaluated, 3 SHORT (IAUM/QLD/USO; QLD placed on alpaca_paper), 3 below tau. BUG 1: 7/13 refused insufficient_bars. SPY 223, QQQ 221, IWM 215, TLT 243, SLV 267, TQQQ 238, GDX 203 vs MIN_BARS 337. The builder asks limit=400 1h, but the Alpaca client returns about 200-270; likely limit is mapped to a calendar lookback too short for IEX hours. Fix: widen or page the Alpaca 1h lookback (Tier 2, market-data path). BUG 2: IAUM and USO SHORTs were multi_account_dispatched with accounts_placed 0, refusal reason not read (suspects: same-symbol exclusivity vs iaum_pullback_1d, or shorting not allowed). Read the refusal from audit_query, then fix or record. [2026-11-05 12:00Z lane ML-ENTRY-SERVE-FIXES session_01AFoLuK7HeWiq4wwSKqN47K, Manager 2026-11-05a/b] BUG 1 MEASURED persisting (relays #23280/#23285): SPY insufficient_bars:223 at every decision 11-03/04 16:00Z+20:00Z, GDX 203 on 11-02 and 11-04 -- a constant per-symbol cap, not the 110-day lookback. FIX (Tier 2, HELD PR on branch lane/ml-entry-alpaca-bar-paging): AlpacaMarketData.get_ohlcv follows next_page_token until limit (bounded 10 pages; later-page failure keeps what was read; INFO line on a short frame). Inferred cause, not venue-verified (no Alpaca key in the lane); the deploy observation settles it: next 16:00Z ETF decision, 13/13 evaluated, none insufficient_bars. BUG 2 MEASURED (operator_alerts): USO rejected by Alpaca 'only day orders are allowed for hard-to-borrow asset' (GTC bracket) -> filed PI-20261105-WSKQN47K-0001 (order path, Tier 3 merge); IAUM refused ml_entry_symbol_held:net_qty=-137.0 = the exclusive-hold rule (by design). PARITY: clock MEASURED, live decides 16:00Z/20:00Z vs research 16:30Z/20:30Z (EST); feature basis stated from code; per-feature gap NOT measured (no Alpaca data key) -> PI-20261105-WSKQN47K-0002 on the A41F reader. Record: comms/research/ml_entry_alpaca_bar_parity/serve_clock_20261105.json. [2026-11-05 12:55Z lane ML-ENTRY-SERVE-FIXES] #23298 MERGED ~12:45Z by Manager 2026-11-05b (squash 33b8d354, Tier 2 data-settled on relays #23280/#23285). landed_unproven: merged, deploy + observation pending; the manager's send_later reads the 16:00Z decision. The per-feature parity measurement moved to PI-20261105-WSKQN47K-0002; the USO hard-to-borrow order-path fix to PI-20261105-WSKQN47K-0001.
